parsed.rationale: Both `MainActorNotificationMessageSequence` and `AsyncNotificationMessageSequence` are `type-alias-object` records in the same `Core` package, living in sibling files `Observation/MainActorMessage.swift` and `Observation/AsyncMessage.swift`. Despite sharing 3 structural fields, they carry distinct names that signal intentionally different semantic roles: one is scoped to `@MainActor` dispatch, the other is a general async notification sequence. Type aliases by definition have no body to deduplicate, and the structural overlap is almost certainly a coincidence of the underlying generic type they both alias rather than a true duplication. No restraint markers are present, but the domain distinction between actor-isolated and general async contexts is sufficient reason to leave them separate.
